introHtml: Polyester tank tops are a go-to for events and teams that need moisture-wicking performance and durable color retention. Whether you're outfitting a race crew with reversible mesh tanks or branding racerback tops for a charity walk, polyester holds up to repeated wear and washing without fading. These tops accept screen printing and embroidery cleanly, making your logo stand out on a lightweight, breathable fabric that keeps wearers cool.
